The '''Yarille system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Fath sector/Legends|Fath sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Yarille]].
